story.text: A very special island is inhabited only by altruists and egoists. Altruists always tell the truth, and egoists always lie. You meet 2 inhabitants: Sofia, and Daniel. In a statement by Sofia: "Sofia is an altruist and Daniel is an altruist". As Daniel put it, "if Daniel is an altruist then Sofia is an egoist". So who is an altruist and who is an egoist? (Format your answer like: "Sofia is a altruist/egoist, and Daniel is a altruist/egoist")

options: Sofia is an egoist, Daniel is an altruist
Sofia is an egoist, Daniel is an egoist
Sofia is an altruist, Daniel is an altruist
Sofia is an altruist, Daniel is an egoist
